selected_skill.purpose: Guide the solver through React state architecture, URL and UI synchronization, on-demand code loading, and keyboard-safe interaction patterns without changing task data, tests, or the bound skill itself.
task_design_intent: Keep the instruction focused on observable frontend regressions, delivery contract, and prohibitions.
Move the diagnosis pressure for state ownership, routing, lazy-loading, and focus management into the skill and the verifier.
Make with_skill and without_skill differ only by environment/skills and the corresponding runtime copy logic.

live_services: hidden in-container energy API on port 3001
data_properties: deterministic local snapshots derived from public OWID energy data and World Bank country metadata
multi-field country records with region, income level, generation, demand, and electricity mix slices
alternate fixture support to catch hardcoded region ordering and static UI shortcuts

principles: State the product symptoms and required frontend behavior before any technical hints.
Describe the available code, local API, and input data as the authoritative surface.
Avoid spelling out hook, reducer, lazy-loading, or focus-management implementation details in the instruction.
Explicitly prohibit replacing the real chain, deleting functionality, changing input data, or introducing a parallel page.
expected_solver_discovery: Recognize that URL, local state, and rendered state currently fight each other.
Identify that heavy comparison code is loading before the user requests it.
Repair keyboard interaction and focus behavior inside the real DOM instead of bypassing the workflow.

main_tests: real hidden API response is used and matches the frozen snapshot semantics
deep-link state survives load, reload, and history navigation without drifting to stale local state
comparison workspace chunk is not requested before the user opens it, but does load and work on demand
keyboard close and focus return behavior works in the details drawer
repeated drawer interactions do not leak runtime listeners
guardrails: input data and hidden API implementation remain unchanged
alternate fixture changes the Europe ranking and must appear in the UI after API restart
agent log may be inspected for skill access when skill artifacts are present
verifier_design.failure_target: Without-skill failures should concentrate on action-level misses such as stale state ownership, broken browser history behavior, eager loading of heavy UI, or missing keyboard/focus repair, not merely cosmetic formatting issues.

experiment_protocol.isolation_rule: Every experiment run must start from a fresh isolated runtime copy.
experiment_protocol.with_without_diff: The only allowed difference is whether environment/skills is present and copied into the runtime.
experiment_protocol.required_result_state: Do not finalize the template README until oracle and at least three valid with-skill/without-skill comparison runs have been collected.
